newsitem.title: USA: U.S. October housing starts rate lowest in a year.
newsitem.headline: U.S. October housing starts rate lowest in a year.

text.p: U.S. builders broke ground on new homes and apartments at the slowest rate in a year during October, the Commerce Department said on Tuesday, as the housing industry steadily lost steam.
Total starts fell 5.1 percent to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.366 million -- the lowest rate since 1.351 million in October 1995 -- after a revised 6.1 percent drop in October.
Applications for building permits declined for a third consecutive month, suggesting the pace of building will continue to wind down in coming months.
